theme_and_archetype.reasoning: Outdoor field usage requires high contrast, maximum legibility, and no visual clutter. Moving away from 6 pastel colors to a rigorous, utilitarian monochrome base with a single intentional accent color.

interactive.accent: bg-blue-600 hover:bg-blue-700 text-white (Use exclusively for key conversion: Request Review)

spacing_and_layout.layout_strategy: Mobile-first vertical stack. Strict hierarchy: 1. Identity, 2. Quick Comms, 3. Business Context (Stats), 4. History (Tabs). Floating Action Drawer for 'Create' actions.

ClientHeader.description: Clean presentation of who the client is.
ClientHeader.structure: Avatar (Initials, h-20 w-20), Name (H1), Company & Tagline. Remove boxy cards, let this sit naturally on the background.
ClientHeader.layout: flex flex-col items-center text-center pt-8 pb-4 gap-2

ContactChips.description: High-priority quick actions (Call, Email, Map) and Review request.
ContactChips.structure: A grid/flex row of 3 circular icon buttons for comms. Below it, a full-width outline button for 'Solicitar Reseña de Google'.
ContactChips.styling: Icon buttons: variant='secondary' rounded-full h-12 w-12. Review button: variant='outline' w-full border-zinc-300.

StatsGrid.description: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look) to present numbers cleanly without card bloat.
StatsGrid.structure: 2x2 CSS Grid with border-collapse. Inner borders only. No drop shadows.
StatsGrid.styling: grid grid-cols-2 border border-zinc-200 rounded-xl overflow-hidden bg-white. Each cell has p-4 border-r border-b border-zinc-100 last:border-0.

HistoryTabs.description: Replaces the 6 giant colorful boxes. A horizontal scrollable segmented control.
HistoryTabs.structure: Use Shadcn Tabs. The TabsList MUST be overflow-x-auto, whitespace-nowrap, and hide the scrollbar (scrollbar-width: none).
HistoryTabs.styling: TabsList: bg-zinc-100 p-1 rounded-xl flex w-full justify-start overflow-x-auto. TabsTrigger: data-[state=active]:bg-white data-[state=active]:shadow-sm rounded-lg px-4 py-2.

FloatingActionDrawer.description: The solution to the '30 buttons' problem. Consolidates all 'Create' actions into one thumb-friendly spot.
FloatingActionDrawer.structure: A fixed bottom bar (z-50) with a single massive '+ Nuevo' button. Clicking it opens a Shadcn Drawer.
FloatingActionDrawer.drawer_contents: A clean vertical list menu of the 5 actions: Quote AI, Invoice, Contrato, Mensaje, Scope AI. Each with a leading Phosphor Icon.
FloatingActionDrawer.styling: Bottom Bar: fixed bottom-0 left-0 w-full p-4 bg-white/80 backdrop-blur-xl border-t border-zinc-200. Drawer Button: w-full bg-zinc-900 text-white rounded-xl h-14 text-lg font-semibold shadow-lg.

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: All buttons must use Tailwind transition-colors duration-200.
motion_and_interactions.drawer_entrance: Native Shadcn drawer spring animation for smooth bottom-up presentation.
motion_and_interactions.tab_switch: Instant content switch to prevent layout shift jank on mobile.

accessibility_and_testing.contrast: APCA/WCAG AA compliant. Zinc-900 on white is ultra-high contrast.
accessibility_and_testing.touch_targets: All interactive elements (tabs, contact buttons, drawer items) MUST be minimum 48x48px physical size equivalent.

data_testid_rules.requirement: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

instructions_to_main_agent: Do NOT use HTML inputs, use Shadcn primitives.
Implement the layout strictly as mobile-first vertical flow.
Place the ClientHeader at the top with no surrounding card.
Implement the StatsGrid as a flat 2x2 grid with 1px internal borders (border-collapse style) inside a single container with a rounded-xl border.
Hide the 6 colorful tabs and replace them with Shadcn Tabs with a horizontally scrollable TabsList.
Move all 5 creation actions (Quote, Invoice, etc) OUT of the main page body and put them inside the FloatingActionDrawer.
Ensure the bottom of the main content has pb-24 so the floating action bar doesn't overlap the last items.
